description: The agent must: (1) Read the PRD at docs/requirements/v2/loan_approval_prd_v2.3.txt and parse its form fields, approval flow, roles, and rules. (2) Generate test cases following the exact 7-column Markdown table schema defined in SKILL.md: 用例编号|模块/功能点|用例类型|前置条件|测试步骤|预期结果|优先级. (3) Number cases as TC-001, TC-002, etc. and use ONLY P0/P1/P2/P3 priorities per the SKILL.md definitions. (4) Write test steps with specific field names (申请人姓名, 贷款金额, etc.) and button names (提交审批, 保存草稿, 确认驳回) — never vague phrases. (5) Write expected results with concrete UI feedback (Toast messages, page jumps, color states) — never '操作成功'. (6) Include boundary value tests (e.g., 500-char limit for remark field, 2~10 char limit for name). (7) Cover the amount-based branch (<=500万 vs >500万 triggering CFO review). (8) Test the conditional required field (抵押物描述 becomes mandatory when amount >100万). (9) Test role-based permission isolation including ID number masking for RiskOfficer. (10) Test duplicate-click protection on approval buttons. (11) Append a 需求确认建议(疑问点) section identifying at least 2 of the 3 genuine conflicts in the PRD: the RiskOfficer rejection target node conflict, the concurrent-in-flight applications count conflict, and the remark field max-length conflict.
